S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  ABA No.904 of 2024  Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Sanjay Kumar, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. S.C. Dumka, AGA for the State.

Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in Criminal Case No.01 of 2023, State vs. Sushil Soni, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar, which is based on FIR No.293 of 2022, under Sections 376, 417, 504 & 506 IPC, Police Station ITI, District Udham Singh Nagar.

entities.text: Police Station ITI, District Udham Singh Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
According to the FIR, the applicant and the informant came close to each other in the year 2008.
The applicant under the pretext of marriage established physical relationship with the informant on multiple occasions.
But, thereafter, finally on 02.09.2022, he declined for marriage.
Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that no offence is made out against the applicant.
The applicant and the informant both are major.
During the investigation, the arrest of the applicant was stayed by the Coordinate Bench of this Court.
Now, charge-sheet has been filed.
State to file objections.

Having considered the submissions, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach any witness in any manner, whatsoever, the victim or any other witness in the case.

(ii) The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the court concerned.
(iii) The applicant shall deposit his passport with the court concerned.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the court concerned.
(iv) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i), (ii) & (iii) above.
